throughline.zh: 本週台灣先進封裝、伺服器與製程設備已公布合作及建廠計畫，新增記憶體模組供貨安排、機櫃電源驗證、光模組交付目標與衛星運算客戶送樣資訊。
throughline.en: This week's Taiwan supply-chain disclosures span advanced packaging, servers and process equipment, now supplemented by DRAM allocation, rack-power qualification, optical shipment targets and satellite-compute sampling.

title.zh: 晶圓、先進封裝產線與廠區擴建
title.en: Wafer and advanced-packaging production and facilities

summary.zh: 精材與台積電簽訂先進封裝 oS 模組產能外包協議，首期量產規劃 2029 年。日月光路竹廠一期啟用、二期動土，千億元總投資與未來年營收均屬公司滿載後估計。
summary.en: Xintec signed an outsourcing agreement for TSMC's on-substrate packaging, targeting initial production in 2029. ASE opened Luzhu phase one and started phase two; investment and revenue figures refer to estimated full buildout.

title.zh: 伺服器電源、光通訊及跨國產能規劃
title.en: Server power, optical interconnects and manufacturing plans

summary.zh: 技嘉公布伺服器財報及台灣、美國與馬來西亞擴廠規劃。光寶科 11 月 15 日新報導補充 800VDC 電源量產預測，正文則說明 800G、1.6T 光模組第四季出貨目標；官方已出貨與媒體轉述的未來時程分別呈現。
summary.en: Gigabyte reported server results and expansion plans in Taiwan, the US and Malaysia. New reporting described Lite-On's 800VDC production outlook and Gemtek's Q4 high-speed optical shipment target, distinguishing shipped products from future media-reported milestones.

title.zh: 半導體產值、DRAM 配貨及模組業者毛利
title.en: Semiconductor output, DRAM allocation and module margins

summary.zh: TSIA 此前發布工研院第三季半導體產值統計，全年數字仍為預測。中央社 11 月 15 日新增模組廠供貨安排與毛利率比較，宇瞻稱保留 DRAM 貨源供明年銷售，未提供實際保留量。
summary.en: TSIA previously published ITRI's semiconductor output data and annual forecasts. CNA's November 15 report added a comparison of module makers and Apacer's DRAM supply reservation policy without quantified allocations.

title.zh: 製程化學感測與工廠電力管理
title.en: Chemical sensing and factory power management

summary.zh: Ainos 公布日月光新增 5,000 台化學感測設備採購；聚恆與燿華另啟動宜蘭廠 5.04MW 表後儲能建置。前者有簽訂採購合約，後者仍在工程階段，尚未公布運轉實績。
summary.en: Ainos announced an additional 5,000 chemical sensors ordered by ASE, while Juheng and Unitech began a 5.04MW battery project at a Yilan factory. The former is a procurement contract and the latter a construction project without operating data.

title.zh: 工業電腦、製造場址與衛星運算模組
title.en: Industrial systems, manufacturing sites and satellite compute

summary.zh: 華紙出售觀音廠予元太與神基強固型工業電腦專案均為前期已公告資訊。11 月 15 日捷揚航電及 TASA 新說明既有衛星 GPGPU 的海外送樣與環境測試細節，過去在軌驗證不重複當成新成果。
summary.en: Earlier stories covered E Ink's Guanyin site purchase and Getac's rugged computing projects. Jieyang and TASA added overseas sampling and environmental test detail for a space GPGPU on November 15; its earlier orbital validation is not presented as newly completed.
